abi_rules: x64 Windows only; all exported structs use fixed-width fields with natural 8-byte packing; static_assert offsets/sizes in header
PB_CONTEXT_V1 is caller-owned 512 bytes aligned16, initially zero. Never persisted or populated from JSON. No DLL heap pointer exported.
No arbitrary command line: child image, inputs directory, SystemRoot and LOCALAPPDATA are fixed checked absolute UTF-16 paths; image-only quoted argv; cwd equals inputs.
Caller owns output spec bytes and PI storage. Returned process/thread handles transfer to Python owner once, including partial failure. DLL closes only attribute-list temporaries.
CPSE opaque environment stays private in context; it is never a kernel HANDLE, never CloseHandle/DuplicateHandle/reopened.
One environment create attempt; exactly two arm create attempts policy0 then1 using exact same image/cwd/env/job/spec. Any failed/unknown create blocks following arm.
No ResumeThread, network, GO, SECURITY_CAPABILITIES, token replacement, parent-process override, HANDLE_LIST, or fallback exports.
Only exact HRESULT S_OK=0 plus nonnull yields owned environment. Other nonnegative statuses and failed HRESULT with nonnull are unknown; no launch or blind close.
plan_rules: rootD-T0<=120F; workerD=rootD-5F; workCut=rootD-35F; actual QPC frequency must equal F
Bind/create/arm require current QPC within original T0/workCut both before and after; no relative epoch renewal
Close/unbind consume known ownership before call even if late; late cleanup never qualifies a timely result

binding.dll: Owner checks absolute no-reparse path, PE x64/source manifest and SHA before ctypes.WinDLL; existing guarded worker is ordinary held identity.
binding.processmodel: LoadLibraryExW(L'processmodel.dll',NULL,LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_SYSTEM32), exact four original names; GetModuleFileNameW readback equals expected System32 path. No alternate name/ordinal/private API fallback.

lifecycle.start: Durable external intent before bind/environment/each arm. Native one-shot state consumed before API. Context environment pointer private.
lifecycle.arm: One KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE non-breakaway noninheritable inner Job; exactly SE_ENV+JOB_LIST+AAP policy; CREATE_SUSPENDED/EXTENDED/UNICODE/NO_WINDOW; bInheritHandles FALSE. First held ACSID is external baseline, second exactsame; fixed OS catalog exact2 caps+attrs4 and held image/generation/inner+outer Job independently verified.
lifecycle.close: External journal consumes close authority before pb_close_environment; native consumes pointer before VOID call. Only close_invoked_once/close_returned_normally are observations. No HRESULT/absence/cancellation invented.
lifecycle.unknown: Unknown create/nonreturned close/worker crash retain recovery_required and broker_outcome_unknown. Kernel Job empty or worker exit does not prove opaque environment absence or broker cancellation.
lifecycle.recovery: New exact audit/reconciliation entry may confirm kernel process/Job resources and known local file cleanup, but no supported opaque environment reopen/enumerate/retry-close. No service stop/restart, numeric handle replay, auto retry, global network changes.

independent_decoder.method: Python stdlib bounds-checked FlatBuffer decoder independently checks PSEC identifier, schema1.1 and every permitted field/table/vector, exact path and fixed policy; reject unknown slots/invalid offsets/extra roots. Compare built byte SHA before Create; native pb_verify_spec independently repeats generated verifier+strict field readback.
